name: Clean Snacking
instructions: Pair a protein or fat with a carb in every snack (apple + peanut butter, yogurt + berries) to avoid an energy crash.
Pre-portion snacks into small containers or bags so you are not eating straight from a large bag on autopilot.
Keep a few whole-food snacks visible and ready to go -- convenience determines what you actually reach for.
Watch today's video for easy healthy snack ideas.
